1.text: The function w models the weight, in ounces, of the remaining solid wax of a burning candle as a function of the time x, in hours, after the candle was lit. The graph of y = w(x) is shown. According to the model, what was the weight, in ounces, of the candle's remaining solid wax 12 hours after the candle was lit?

2.text: In triangle ABC, the sum of the measures of angle A and angle B is 159.5°. What is the measure of angle C?

3.text: A local gym is offering a 25% discount on an annual membership. The regular cost of an annual membership is $288. How much less is the discounted cost of the membership than the regular cost of the membership?

4.text: The table shows three values of x and their corresponding values of y. There is a linear relationship between x and y. Which of the following equations represents this relationship?

5.text: The function f is defined by the equation f(x) = 380x. What is the value of f(10)?

6.text: An object traveled 0.20 meters for every 4.0 seconds it was in motion. If the object was in motion for 24 seconds, what is the total distance, in meters, the object traveled?

7.text: Which ordered pair (x, y) is a solution to the given system of equations?

8.text: When a scientist began observing a sample of an isotope, the mass of the sample was 530,000 milligrams. The mass of the sample decreases by half approximately every 5 days. Which of the following is closest to the mass, in milligrams, of the sample 35 days after the scientist began observing the sample?

9.text: The height of a right circular cylinder is 31 inches, and the circumference of its base is 310 inches. Which expression represents the total surface area, in square inches, of the cylinder?

10.text: The function f(w) = 6w² gives the area of a rectangle, in square feet ft², if its width is w ft and its length is 6 times its width. Which of the following is the best interpretation of f(13) = 1,014?

choices.A: If the width of the rectangle is 13 ft, then the area of the rectangle is 1,014 ft².
choices.B: If the width of the rectangle is 13 ft, then the length of the rectangle is 1,014 ft.
choices.C: If the width of the rectangle is 1,014 ft, then the length of the rectangle is 13 ft.
choices.D: If the width of the rectangle is 1,014 ft, then the area of the rectangle is 13 ft².

11.text: The expression (3x + 5)(8x − 7) can be written in the form ax² + bx + c, where a, b, and c are constants. What is the value of a + b?

12.text: The ratio a to b is equivalent to the ratio 49 to 26. What is the value of a when b = 182?

13.text: At the beginning of the year, Imani has $170 in her account. Each month this year, she will deposit between $30 and $60 into the account. Which inequality represents all possibilities for the total amount of money x, in dollars, in Imani's account after 10 months of deposits this year?

14.text: The function f is defined by f(x) = 6(x − 2)(x − 4). In the xy-plane, the graph of y = h(x) is the result of translating the graph of y = f(x) up 6 units. What is the y-coordinate of the y-intercept of the graph of y = h(x)?

15.text: A circle has a circumference of 28π centimeters. What is the diameter, in centimeters, of the circle?

16.text: How many solutions does the equation 35x − 25 = 35x − 25 have?

17.text: On January 1, 2000, the population of a town was 26,257 and on January 1, 2010, the population was 26,858. The equation 10x + 26,257 = 26,858 describes this situation. Which of the following is the best interpretation of x in this context?

choices.A: The total increase in population between 2000 and 2010
choices.B: The projected population of the town 10 years after 2010
choices.C: The average increase per year of the population between 2000 and 2010
choices.D: The percentage by which the population of the town increased each year between 2000 and 2010

18.text: For the linear function f, f(−5) = −7, and the slope of the graph of y = f(x) in the xy-plane is 3. Which equation defines f?

19.text: In the xy-plane, an equation of circle A is (x − 2)² + (y − 7)² = 25. Circle B has the same center as circle A but has a radius that is twice the radius of circle A. Which equation represents circle B?

20.text: Line k contains the points (−3, −60), (v, 0), and (5, 76). What is the value of v?

21.stimulus: Right triangle FGH with right angle at H, angle G = 60°, and hypotenuse FG = 68. Note: Figure not drawn to scale.
21.text: In right triangle FGH shown, what is the value of cos F?

22.text: Based on a model, on day 1 of an 8-day experiment, a lima bean plant had an estimated mass of 253 grams, and each day after day 1 of the experiment, the estimated mass of the plant decreased by 4 grams. Which equation represents this model, where m is the estimated mass, in grams, of the plant on day x of the experiment and 1 ≤ x ≤ 8?
